function: Learns RIS phase shifts and per-IoTD energy partition (offloading transmit power versus local computing) to maximize sum computation rate in RIS-aided MEC uplink (pp. 2-3).
system: p. 2: BS with N antennas (value not given), K=6 single-antenna IoTDs, one reflecting RIS with M elements (20 to 100 in Fig. 4); 1 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated.
method: p. 3: Twin delayed DDPG (TD3) actor-critic deep reinforcement learning; state holds channels and previous rates, action is phase shifts and energy partitions, reward is sum rate.
data_channel: p. 3: All channels follow Rician fading (LoS plus Rayleigh NLoS, Rician factor); no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measurement used; no separate test channels described.
test_conditions: pp. 3-4: Reward versus episodes for M=20, 40, 60; sum rate swept over M, K and energy budget; no transfer to unseen conditions described.
baselines: p. 3: DDQN [15] (learned, same problem); No RIS case with TD3 energy partition (variant of proposed method). No non-learned baseline.
metrics: pp. 3-4: Sum computation rate versus M, K, and energy budget; reward versus episodes; 7.71% and 43.69% gains over DDQN and No RIS at M=60.
q1_support: p. 3: "all channels obey the Rician fading channel models". Custom Rician simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.901 model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 3: "Fig. 3 plots the reward versus episodes under M = 20, M = 40, M = 60". The paper only sweeps M, K and the energy budget (Figs. 4 to 6) and never states that a trained model is tested on unseen conditions or adapted.
q3_support: p. 3: "energy partition strategies are obtained based on TD3 algorithm" (No RIS case) and "we use DDQN algorithm [15]". DDQN is learned; No RIS is a TD3 variant; no non-learned baseline such as random or fixed RIS or an optimization algorithm.
q4_support: p. 3: "does not increase the proposed TD3-based scheme's convergence time" is only a qualitative statement on convergence. No complexity order, FLOPs, parameters, or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 3: "all channels obey the Rician fading channel models". Simulated channels; no link, DOI, or release of code or data, and no public channel dataset, is given.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned RIS phase shifts are a physical-layer decision learned jointly with the energy partition of offloading versus local computing, so the above_phy rule does not exclude it. The number of BS antennas N and the carrier frequency are not given. The No RIS benchmark still learns the energy partition with TD3, so it is an ablation of the proposed method, not a non-learned baseline; this is the judgement behind q3 = 0.
